exposure: Categorical risk assessment for early-onset sepsis
outcome: Blood culture obtained within 72 hours of birth
cohort: 1,187 late preterm (≥35(0/7)-36(6/7) weeks' gestational age) and term infants born via cesarean section with rupture of membranes < 10 minutes
finding: Utilizing the Neonatal Early-Onset Sepsis Risk Calculator would have led to a significant reduction in the number of infants receiving a blood culture but no reduction in antibiotic exposure.
gest_age: Late preterm (≥35(0/7)-36(6/7) weeks' gestational age) and term
